bugs_found: transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float/int-like inputs can cause TypeError during Decimal arithmetic or inconsistent behavior compared with the other functions.

compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate non-integer years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), which can produce incorrect financial results instead of rejecting invalid fractional periods.
fx_convert does not validate that exchange rates are positive, so zero or negative rates can produce nonsensical converted amounts.
